items.caption: This tile shows all Comet WiFi thermostats at a glance. It finds the devices on its own — new thermostats appear without further action, deleted ones disappear.
The tile only reads the variables of the device instances and controls through their functions. It has no MQTT connection of its own; a fault here cannot affect the connection of the devices.
"Off" and "On" are the device's end stops (valve closed or open) and are named rather than shown as a temperature.
Hidden devices go unnoticed when they fail — that is why they are visible by default.

items.name: ClockWarnMinutes
items.caption: Report device clock from a deviation of
The weekly schedule runs in the thermostat. If its clock is wrong, every switching point is shifted by the same amount. 0 switches the warning off.

items.name: AllowControl
items.caption: Target temperature adjustable in the tile

Adjustment is done in half-degree steps via the device instance. This means the switch to manual mode also applies here, if switched on there — otherwise the weekly schedule would overwrite the value at the next switching point.

After a module update, Symcon does not always apply an instance's settings by itself. The only other way is to change something in the form and change it back — only then does "Apply" become clickable at all. This button saves you that.
⚠️  Acts on the saved settings. Anything you changed above but have not applied yet is lost.
This is harmless for the devices: applying sends nothing and therefore does not wake any battery.
